facts.text: Caroline participated in a pride parade on Friday, which was described as having a lot of energy and love.

evidence.quote: I went to a pride parade last Friday and it was awesome - so much energy and love everywhere.

facts.text: Caroline uses her art to express her trans experience and help people understand the trans community.

evidence.quote: My art is about expressing my trans experience. It's my way of showing my story and helping people understand the trans community.

facts.text: Caroline represents inclusivity and diversity in her art and uses it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community.

evidence.quote: Representing inclusivity and diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance.

facts.text: Caroline was inspired by a crowd celebrating love and acceptance at an event, which motivated her to continue fighting for LGBTQ rights.

evidence.quote: People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
